candidates.snippet: 1913: Hitler moves to Munich - Hitler relocated to Munich, a move that would significantly shape his political future and the course of German history. 1925: Publication of Mein Kampf - The first volume of Hitler's autobiographical manifesto, Mein Kampf, was published, outlining his political ideology and future plans. 1933: Hitler becomes Chancellor - Adolf Hitler was appointed Chancellor of Germany, marking the beginning of his absolute control and the end of the Weimar Republic. 1939: Invasion of Poland - Germany's invasion of Poland, ordered by Hitler, triggered declarations of war on his country by France and the United Kingdom, initiating World War II.
